metadata.title: Guidelines for Authorisation of Clinical Trials of Medicines and Allied Substances in Zambia (ZAMRA), CT_GUD_001
metadata.edition: Uploaded October 2026 · not read: scanned PDF without a text layer
metadata.legal_basis: ZAMRA guideline under Part VI of the Medicines and Allied Substances Act 2013; the Act prevails.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
